My Pokémon Ranch → RanchPack493

v0.2: reuses the working Ranch viewer decoder, but also predecodes the Ranch TEX0/PLT0 textures in the browser. Gen1Recomp/Gen2Recomp never has to read the giant textures.brres bank; it only range-reads the small RGBA texture needed by each mesh.

1. Select your own My Pokémon Ranch WAD

No Ranch assets are embedded. WAD decryption, ASH/U8 extraction and texture conversion happen locally in this page.

2. Downloads

Install the generated Gen1 or Gen2 ZIP. When Recomp asks for the required import, choose the RanchPack493.pack generated in the same run. These ZIPs include the Ranch art-style options and world filter.

Download RanchPack493.packDownload RanchImporterGen1.zipDownload RanchImporterGen2.zip
Ready. This builder outputs RanchPack493 plus the latest Ranch importer ZIPs for Gen1 and Gen2.
